taxonomy.T-CLEAN: control: clean born-digital text, must not regress
taxonomy.T-TINY: text below the resolution the default render DPI can resolve
taxonomy.T-LOWCON: low contrast between ink and background
taxonomy.T-ROT: page or region rotated away from horizontal
taxonomy.T-SKEW: small skew angle, as from a scanner or camera
taxonomy.T-CMAP: text layer present but wrongly decoded (broken ToUnicode)
taxonomy.O-WATERMARK: large translucent watermark across the page
taxonomy.L-MULTICOL: multi-column layout with a real gutter
taxonomy.B-TINYCELL: table with small text inside cells
taxonomy.X-COMBO: two failure modes interacting on one page

cases.expected_behavior: native digital route; all diacritics preserved exactly
cases.notes: Control case. Any diacritic loss here invalidates every harder Vietnamese result.

cases.expected_behavior: native route recovers it exactly (text layer intact); the visual route needs higher DPI than the 200 default
cases.notes: Native and visual routes should diverge sharply here — that divergence is the measurement, not a bug.

cases.expected_behavior: native text layer is intact so the native route must succeed; OCR on the render is where contrast matters
rotated text must still be recovered; reading order will likely be wrong and that is a separate, recorded failure
native route recovers the occluded text (it is under the seal, not replaced); the visual route cannot and should say so
cases.notes: The point of this case is that native and visual routes fail DIFFERENTLY. A fusion strategy should beat either alone.

cases.expected_behavior: body text recovered; the watermark itself is content, not noise, and should appear rather than be silently dropped
text recovered; table STRUCTURE likely lost by the native finder, which keys on vector ruling lines
cases.notes: Expected-fail for the native table backend by construction. The value is measuring whether a specialist or VLM recovers the grid.

cases.expected_behavior: cell text recovered; row/col spans are the hard part
both columns recovered AND ordered column-by-column, not interleaved line-by-line across the gutter
cases.notes: Reading order is the measurement here, not text recovery.

cases.expected_behavior: ruled table detected; 5pt cell text is the interacting difficulty
cases.notes: Deliberate interaction of B-TINYCELL and T-TINY: real invoices combine them.

cases.expected_behavior: 3 pages; repeated header/footer identifiable as such rather than interleaved into body text 3 times
cases.notes: Cross-page structure: the repeated strings are the signal.

cases.expected_behavior: table structure survives; the amount under the stamp is recoverable natively but not visually
cases.notes: Interaction of O-STAMP and B-* — the combination real invoices actually present.

cases.expected_behavior: quality gate must reject the text layer and reroute to OCR; accepting it silently is the worst possible outcome
cases.notes: Regression lock on the failure the whole routing architecture exists for.
